description: Get the legal record of a tokenized property: the trust that holds it (holding entity, formation date), the trust agreement that governs the token (name, version, link), the legal description, the parcel identifiers (FIPS, APN, county, state), the recorded deed reference and grantor, and documents the owner uploaded. The agreement text is included only when includeAgreementText is true (it is long); trust.agreementResource is the MCP resource with this token's own agreement. Owner names: the deed grantor from Fabrica's own records is returned; a holder's chosen display name is in get_property; owner names from third-party parcel data are never returned. Property checks are not a title search or title insurance.

includeAgreementText.description: Also return the full text of the trust agreement, about 150 KB (default: false; the link is always returned)

tokenId.description: The token ID of the property

name: get_trust_documents
title: Get trust documents
